treatment: The package of the reading surface (split Markdown pages for an AI reader), authored from design A3: the public surface is build, finalize and the reader in serve; the frozen interface stays in api.py

The frozen interface of the reading surface authored from design A3 section 12.1: re-exports of the envelope renderer, enc, the budgets and the sentinel functions, plus the family-class helpers; no reference code read or copied

Items, units and the section renderer authored from design A3 sections 2.3-2.5: the one function that both measures a candidate page and writes the final one, exactly invertible folding of long lines, and the cut of a unit that is too long into parts at row seams; pure functions
Byte budgets of the reading surface authored from design A3 D-4 and section 1.2: page and card caps, the twin ratio, line limits, the card field caps and the envelope limits; pure data

The three scope-card lines of a page (covers, excludes, howto) authored from design A3 2.5 and AM-14: parts in priority order, whole parts dropped until the line fits its byte cap, the legends a page needs; pure functions

The build-time checks RS-101 to RS-133 authored from design A3 section 6: classes I, L and T, each check reads the written text, the manifest rows and the bundle; the exclusion proof of the conservation check; the surface of a written dist
deviations: RS-108, RS-110, RS-114, RS-115 and RS-127 are registered and not applicable before milestones R2 and R3

treatment: The body of a page of one family or of several families (single-page mode and folded dimensions) authored from design A3 2.4; pure functions

The page frame authored from design A3 section 2.5: locator lines, scope card, neighbour line, sentinel, the finalize step and the sentinel check, and the worst-case frame size the planner reserves; pure functions
deviations: Continuation parts are checked against the wide envelope bucket and a screen card has its own bucket; the design text left both open

treatment: The page families S D M W R T E C authored from design A3 section 2.2: how the fragments of the deepest document and the views rendered from the model become units and sections; every fact is printed as it is or rendered as a view with its own role
deviations: Case acceptance rows are homed on the case pages and requirement acceptance rows on the requirement pages (the design table lists the acceptance rows with the requirements); interventions have no page in this milestone

treatment: manifest.jsonl and its writer authored from design A3 2.7.1, D-7, D-34 and D-35: scan after the build, complete the rows from the bytes on disk, classify what the build did not make, header, written last
The data types of the reading surface (configuration, finding, result) authored from design A3 sections 6.0 and 12.1; plain dataclasses
Page ids with the section sign, the page families, paths and twins and the file-name encoding enc, authored from design A3 sections 2.5-2.6 and D-5; pure functions
deviations: enc escapes a literal leading underscore that would collide with the device-name prefix and a trailing dot, and the device prefix and the hash fallback follow design 2.6 otherwise

treatment: Page assembly authored from design A3 sections 2.5 and 2.7: frame from the envelope renderer, cross-references resolved once every page has its id, the manifest record and the ids.tsv rows taken from the final text
Reading a finished page back (frame, scope card, sections, tables, folded lines) authored from design A3 2.5; the templates of derive/i18n are the only source of the expressions
reading.build authored from design A3 sections 2.10 and 12.1: a pure function from the bundle to the files, the manifest rows and every finding
The planner authored from design A3 sections 2.3 and 2.4: real envelope reservation, seams, continuation parts, one-page mode and folded dimensions; it measures rendered lines and estimates nothing
deviations: A third folded page P3Q holds the small families of 3D, 4D and QA: the design asks for them to be folded when the fan-out bound is exceeded in the 10-20 KB band

treatment: The quality page authored from design A3 2.2 row Q and D-27: the quality fields as they are, the withheld items, the exclusion table

The HTML twins of the reading pages authored from design A3 sections 2.5, 2.6 and D-2: one inline and block grammar for the renderer and for the visible-text normalisation, ids unique by construction, link rewriting, line folding that never changes a visible character, and the structural reader the twin checks use; standard library only; no reference code read or copied
The reader of the written pages for the doc and index tools authored from design A3 5.2, 5.3 and 2.9: size checked before reading, stamp comparison, the failure codes
What the page builder reads from a bundle authored from design A3 2.2 and D-3: homes of the fragments of the deepest document by group, reading order of the nodes, helpers over the model
START, the glossary, the dimension INDEX cards, docs/README.md and the rg ignore list authored from design A3 2.7.4, 2.7.5 and 2.11
ids.tsv and refs.tsv authored from design A3 2.7.2 and 2.7.3: one line per home and per view, references listed only where the owner prints them, the rest counted
